cohort: 120 pregnant women (60 with preeclampsia and 60 with normal BP)
finding: Pregnant women with preeclampsia had significantly lower levels of vitamin D compared to those with normal pregnancies.
mod_finding: The study examined the relationship between vitamin D levels and preeclampsia but did not investigate mode of delivery.
gest_age: Preeclampsia was defined as hypertension after 20 weeks of gestation.
